If they play Steam Vents untapped on turn 2 (paying 2 life), they'd have Island + Steam Vents = U + U/R, which doesn't cast No More Lies (WU). They'd need to play Restless Anchorage on turn 2 (which enters tapped) to eventually have WU, but then No More Lies isn't available on turn 2. The correct line is to play Steam Vents untapped (paying 2 life) on turn 1, then play Restless Anchorage tapped on turn 2, having access to No More Lies on turn 3. Alternatively, playing Steam Vents turn 1 and Island turn 2 still doesn't give WU. Actually, let me reconsider: the hand has Island, Restless Anchorage, Steam Vents. Restless Anchorage enters tapped and produces W or U. Steam Vents produces U or R. No More Lies costs WU. To cast No More Lies on turn 2, they need W and U available. The only way is to have Restless Anchorage (untapped) + Island or Steam Vents. Since Restless Anchorage enters tapped, playing it turn 1 means it's available turn 2. Then playing Island or Steam Vents turn 2 gives them WU on turn 2. Playing Island turn 1 means Restless Anchorage on turn 2 enters tapped, so No More Lies isn't available until turn 3. This is a meaningful sequencing error that delays the counterspell by a full turn.
